name: Su Birikintisi
scene: Two striped Wellington rain boots stand at staggered heights in a puddle beneath flowing rainy-sky bands.
notes: Design sheet only; target 21–31 panes. Generated twice and visually reviewed. Final simplified composition keeps warm boots and cool background colour pairs. Remaining doubts: subtle shading persists; adjacent toe and ankle pieces share a colour and may merge during tracing; a few stripe/background junctions are too closely aligned and need separation during geometry preparation. Generator returned transparent exterior instead of opaque white; display on white. Not geometry-audited or published.
